capabilities: Render crochet code blocks as SVG stitch charts (flat, round, and spiral layouts)
Track row and per-stitch progress with an embedded checklist and counter
Mark yarn color changes and lace-style stitch placement in charts
Draw blank polar or rectangular drafting grids for designing patterns
Provide a copyable AI pattern-authoring skill for converting written patterns
extras: Runs entirely locally with no network requests or telemetry; very large patterns are rejected with inline errors (documented limits) instead of freezing the preview. Progress is stored in the plugin data.json file.
problem: Obsidian has no way to turn written crochet patterns into visual stitch charts, so crocheters must read raw shorthand or draw charts in other tools.

relations.evidence: Drop skills/crochet-weaver-pattern/ into your project's or your home .claude/skills/ folder

summary: Renders crochet stitch charts as SVG from text patterns in code blocks, with an embedded row-and-stitch progress tracker.
